NAVs are calculated under AIC methodology and the debt fair value uses a discount rate based on UK gilt redemption yields plus ICE BofAML index credit spreads applied daily; referenced notes are 4.53% 2029, 2.67% 2046 and 2.94% 2049. All NAV calculations use the AIC methodology and exclude treasury shares. The company's debt fair value is an estimate of its senior unsecured notes using a discount rate based on the relevant UK gilt redemption yield plus a credit spread; that discount rate is updated monthly and applied daily to published NAVs.
